SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tenant_members tm INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = tm.user_id AND u.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE tm.deleted_at IS NULL AND tm.status = 'active'

SELECT htc.tool_name AS "toolName", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM amp_tool_calls htc INNER JOIN amp_messages hm ON hm.id = htc.message_id INNER JOIN amp_sessions hc ON hc.id = hm.conversation_id GROUP BY htc.tool_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT htc.tool_name AS "toolName", COUNT(*) AS "errorCount" FROM amp_tool_calls htc INNER JOIN amp_messages hm ON hm.id = htc.message_id INNER JOIN amp_sessions hc ON hc.id = hm.conversation_id WHERE htc.status = 'error' GROUP BY htc.tool_name
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_bases WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND is_temporary = false
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(type, ''), 'document') AS "kbType", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM knowledge_bases WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND is_temporary = false GROUP BY 1

SELECT k.file_type AS "fileType", COUNT(*) AS "count", COALESCE(SUM(k.file_size), 0) AS "storageSize" FROM knowledges k INNER JOIN knowledge_bases kb ON kb.id = k.knowledge_base_id WHERE k.deleted_at IS NULL AND kb.deleted_at IS NULL AND kb.is_temporary = false GROUP BY k.file_type

SELECT COUNT(kb.id) score, kb.id, kb.name, kb.description, kb.type FROM messages m LEFT JOIN knowledges k ON k.id = m.knowledge_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_bases kb ON kb.id = k.knowledge_base_id WHERE m.knowledge_id IS NOT NULL AND m.knowledge_id <> '' GROUP BY kb.id ORDER BY score DESC
SELECT agent_id AS "agentId", COUNT(*) AS "conversationCount" FROM amp_sessions GROUP BY agent_id
SELECT NULL::text AS "agentId", 0::bigint AS "totalFeedbacks", 0::bigint AS "likeFeedbacks" WHERE false
